owner.name: Khushboo Khan
owner.tagline: I plan the work, track the tasks, and finish projects on time.
owner.summary: Khushboo works in project management. She has two years of experience as an administrator in an educational institute, has led a university group project, and has completed a project management training program. She holds a master's equivalent degree in Educational Leadership and Management. She likes clear goals, steady progress, and teams that know what to do next.
owner.approach: She uses clear plans and simple updates to keep teams moving from the first idea to the final delivery. Her working style is summed up as Plan, Track, Deliver.
